title: Download an invoice or VAT receipt
body: Open Settings → Billing → Invoices. Each line has a Download PDF button, and the PDF includes your VAT number and our tax details. Invoices appear within an hour of payment.

title: Duplicate or unexpected charge
body: A charge can appear twice when a card retry overlaps a successful payment; the duplicate is auto-reversed within 5–7 business days. If it hasn't cleared after 7 days, a teammate can refund the duplicate directly.

title: Reset your password
body: Use Forgot password on the sign-in page. The email arrives within a few minutes; check spam, and make sure you're using the address you signed up with. Links expire after 60 minutes.

title: Password reset email not arriving
body: If the reset email never arrives, it's almost always a different sign-up address or an aggressive spam filter. We can confirm the address on file and trigger a manual reset.

title: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA)
body: Go to Settings → Security → Two-factor and scan the QR code with any authenticator app. Save the backup codes somewhere safe — they're the only way back in if you lose the device.

title: Create a second workspace
body: Settings → Workspaces → New workspace. Each workspace has its own members, billing, and data. You can switch between them from the top-left workspace menu.

title: Export your data to CSV
body: Settings → Data → Export produces a CSV of your records; the download link is emailed to you and stays valid for 24 hours. Large accounts may take a few minutes to generate.

title: Dashboard blank or 502 error
body: A blank dashboard with a 502 usually means a transient outage on our side. Check status.example.com for live incidents; a hard refresh (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R) clears a stale cache once the incident is resolved.
